nodes.label: GitHub Actions secrets as the only secret store
nodes.rationale: PRD hard constraint: secrets live in GitHub Actions secrets / Vercel env vars, never in the repo, the DB, or a fixture.

nodes.label: DATABASE_URL (Supabase service-role pooler string)
nodes.rationale: Must be the owner/service-role pooler string on port 6543: migration 0004 enables RLS on every table with no policies, so anon and authenticated keys are denied outright and only the owner role bypasses.

nodes.label: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY
nodes.rationale: One 32-byte base64 key used everywhere — the INDmoney login encrypts the refresh token with it and CI sync decrypts with it. If the local and CI values diverge, sync silently falls back to the file snapshot and the login must be re-run.

nodes.label: TELEGRAM_OWNER_CHAT_ID
nodes.rationale: The bot is locked to this single chat id; every other id is ignored (PRD 4.1, 12.3). It is read once out of the getUpdates reply and never committed.

nodes.label: BACKUP_REPO / BACKUP_BRANCH / GH_TOKEN
nodes.rationale: A separate private GitHub repo holds the encrypted dumps, pushed with a PAT carrying `repo` scope — keeping backups out of the application repo.

nodes.label: Supabase hosted Postgres project
nodes.rationale: Free tier, Mumbai region (ref uqzbocoujennfhdqppdl), migrated and seeded 2026-08-24 with RLS verified on all 18 tables.

nodes.label: RLS-everywhere with owner-role bypass
nodes.rationale: Row level security is on for every table with zero policies, so anon/authenticated keys are denied outright while the owner role bypasses and jobs keep working. Verified with `select tablename, rowsecurity from pg_tables where schemaname='public'` — every row must read `t`. tests/db/immutability.test.ts asserts this but only against PGlite, so the real project must be checked by hand.

nodes.label: Owner-locked Telegram bot
nodes.rationale: Created via @BotFather; the owner must message the bot first because bots cannot initiate. Delivery verified end-to-end 2026-08-24.

nodes.label: One-time interactive INDmoney OAuth login
nodes.rationale: Human-in-loop unlock is the security model: no broker password or TOTP secret is stored, only an encrypted portfolio:read refresh token. The token must be created against the Supabase DB, not the local .pglite, or CI cannot see it.

nodes.label: Vercel-hosted read-only web app
nodes.rationale: Next.js 15 with root directory `web`, single-owner and unlisted rather than authenticated. Every portfolio view is read-only; /import is the sole write path (upload, LLM extraction, owner confirm, DB write). No Kite credentials or order placement reach the web tier.

nodes.label: .env is not auto-loaded (no dotenv dependency)
nodes.rationale: Only `pnpm indmoney:login` uses `tsx --env-file=.env`, and web/next.config.ts parses the root .env itself. Every other script sees only shell-exported variables — the cause of the recurring 'Missing required environment variable: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN'.

nodes.label: Blank-but-present DATABASE_URL throws
nodes.rationale: An unset GitHub secret interpolates to ''. Falling back to embedded PGlite would show a plausible-looking Rs 0 net worth, so the code refuses instead: unset the variable entirely or give it a real URL.

nodes.label: pnpm backup (encrypted pg_dump)
nodes.rationale: AES-256-GCM encrypted dump pushed to the private backup repo; `backup:restore` needs the same key and an empty target DB.

nodes.label: pnpm schedule (order expiry and reminders)
nodes.rationale: Requires the order_intents table from migration 0016_approval_orders.sql; all tasks are idempotent via idempotency keys.

nodes.label: keepalive workflow (Supabase free-tier ping)
nodes.rationale: Sundays 04:00 UTC. It is an audit_log write, not an HTTP ping, because the free tier pauses on database inactivity. Largely subsumed by the daily sync, kept belt-and-braces.

nodes.label: digest workflow (daily digest delivery)
nodes.rationale: No fixed cron — triggered by workflow_run on sync success, so the digest never reads a stale snapshot. A failed sync means no digest that day, which is the intended loud failure.

nodes.label: Headless four-piece deployment topology
nodes.rationale: Phase 0 is not a hosted website: it is Supabase (DB) + a private Telegram bot (messenger) + GitHub Actions cron jobs (compute) + Vercel (read-only UI), all on free tiers, with secrets in Actions.
